title: Launch sprint canvas and release scripts for Private/VPC/on-prem RBAC + Audit + KMS
creator: Aisha Chen
description: Goal: produce an operational launch kit and release scripts that coordinate cross-functional work for the Private/VPC/on-prem rollout of RBAC, audit logging, and KMS integrations. This ticket covers the PM deliverables: a sprint canvas to synchronize teams, a standardized release script/checklist for preflight and cutover, templated release notes snippets, and customer-facing onboarding runbooks. We aim to reduce runbook ambiguity, ensure compliance artifacts are available during sales cycles, and speed enablement for pilots by providing repeatable artifacts and coordinated comms.
acceptance_criteria: Sprint canvas published and reviewed by Eng, Design, Security, and Sales Engineering
Release script has step-by-step preflight, cutover, and rollback sections and is signed off by Infra and SRE
Release notes snippets created for public, partner, and internal channels and approved by Legal
Customer onboarding runbook template (PDF + HTML) with sample telemetry dashboards created and validated in a test pilot
All required security review items completed and documented in the compliance checklist
steps_to_release: Draft sprint canvas with milestones: feature freeze, docs freeze, canary window, GA gate
Work with ENG to enumerate dependencies and queue critical PRs; add to ENG-2891 and ENG-3022
Coordinate design microcopy and screenshots with DES-2049; capture final UI states for release notes
Create release script: preflight (entitlements, KMS key IAM, RBAC mappings), staging validation (audit stream, retention, access), canary runbook, rollback procedure
Run tabletop with SRE, Security, Sales Eng, and Customer Success; collect gaps and update script
Produce three versions of release notes: External short, Partner technical, Internal ops with runbook links
Publish runbooks to Confluence and generate PDF exports for sales/SE enablement
Prepare demo deck and enablement checklist for SEs and TAMs; schedule 2 enablement sessions before GA
Lock release window and create calendar invites for cross-team war room
Tag release in product roadmap and notify affected customers per communications plan
